thread:
emily_r: Heads-up 1) we have an external hire offer that's asking for an L5 title but recruiting put L4 in Workday. Recruiter wants a fast-track comp exception plus immediate title alignment on their start date. What's the short checklist to approve this without blowing payroll cutover?

devin: high-level: need market comp data, hiring manager justification, director ack, and comp partner sign-off. If comp > band midpoint or title bump, we also need two independent reviewer signoffs.

rachel_hr: timeline note: if start date falls in the next payroll cutover (48h), we can't guarantee retro pay adjustments same cycle. Recommend pushing start to next window unless all docs are in by cutover cutoff.

emily_r: recruiter says candidate signs tonight. Can we do an interim title change in the offer letter and finalize Workday after? Any policy blocking that?

devin: offer language can state title "as negotiated" but payroll/profile must match Workday in the first pay. We can do offer-level title + provisional comp, then finalize with a promo/level change case after start. But exceptions must be logged.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: per Promo & External Hire policy v3.0, title-only changes for new hires still require hiring manager justification and HRBP note. Comp changes >10% require Compensation Partner approval. See: https://redwoodintra/confluence/promotions/external-hires

rachel_hr: practical checklist for fast-track (paste below) 1
```
- Candidate name + offer timestamp
- Proposed title & comp (base, bonus, equity outline)
- Market comp evidence (brief excerpt + link)
- Hiring manager justification (1-2 lines)
- Director ack (Slack thread or email)
- HRBP initial review
- Compensation partner approval (required if >10% of band midpoint or bump >1 level)
- Two independent reviewers if internal consistency risk
- Payroll cutover window & expected effective date
```

emily_r: good. For the "two independent reviewers" can one be Talent Acquisition lead? Or must be manager-level?

devin: one reviewer should be a manager from a different org than the hiring manager to avoid conflict; TA lead can be the second reviewer if they are not the direct hiring manager. Comp partner must also weigh in for comp exceptions.

payroll-bot: Note: Cutover windows for 2026 visible here: https://redwoodintra/drive/payroll/cutovers-2026.xlsx. Cutoff for next payroll: 2026-03-01 16:00 PT. Changes submitted after cutoff will process next cycle.

rachel_hr: if recruiter needs the candidate start earlier than payroll can handle, we can do a contractor or consultant onboarding for 2 weeks then convert. That's a non-ideal workaround but sometimes necessary. Must document legal/benefits implications.

emily_r: recruiter pushing back on extra reviewer requirement because they're worried candidate will accept elsewhere. Any fast lanes?

devin: we have a "fast-lane" only for strategic hires where exec sponsor approves an accelerated review. Process: exec sponsor emails people-ops + comp partner with justification, people-ops opens expedited case, reviewers have 4 business hours to sign. Use sparingly.

people-ops-bot: Action item: /task create "Expedite fast-track process doc + template for exec sponsor" assigned to rachel_hr, due 2026-02-28.

emily_r: ok, practical Q 1) When we finalize in Workday post-start, does payroll need retro pay form? how long before retro backpay is issued?

payroll-bot: Payroll: retro pay requests processed within 2 cycles after approved case. Must include signed evidence and effective date. Retro pay is subject to payroll capacity; high-volume retro batches may be delayed one extra cycle.

rachel_hr: also flag: benefits enrollment changes tied to level/comp need HRBP + benefits team cc'ed within 24h of case finalization to avoid missed enrollments.

devin: final operational checklist I recommend adding to the Confluence page: small fields for "is candidate external?", "exec sponsor?", "fast-lane used?", "start date vs cutover window" so recruiters/managers can self-triage.

emily_r: can someone draft the short "what to do now" note I can send to the recruiter? 2 sentences max.

rachel_hr: drafted: "If candidate signs tonight: submit the fast-track packet (market evidence, manager + director ack) to people-ops immediately and request expedited review with exec sponsor. If packet cannot be completed before payroll cutoff, consider a delayed start date or short contractor onboarding to preserve payroll timelines."

emily_r: perfect 1 sending to recruiter. Thanks all. I'll ping once candidate signs or if we need an exec sponsor. :raised_hands:
